fiveStarReviews.author: Robert Plunkett (Bob)
fiveStarReviews.text: Outstanding!  I can’t imagine how anyone could be better than our experience  with Kortech.  Absolutely wonderful, courteous   Knowledgeable .   Fixed several problems that the Apple could not after a 10-day stay. Reasonably priced.  HIGHLY recommend!

fiveStarReviews.author: Ryan White
fiveStarReviews.text: Just had THE best computer repair service of my life. And for what I paid I got a serious deal and same-day repair. I was desperate for a repair and I was apprehensive to go into a shop because I've had bad experiences in this area. Kortech Service was fast, worked over time and at a great price. Im very happy with what my repair!!

fiveStarReviews.author: Tirth Patel
fiveStarReviews.text: This place is amazing! I didn't need help with a computer but my head unit for my truck and Salahuddin (sorry If i spelt it wrong) was able to fix the issue. Installed it in my truck and it works perfect. I also forgot to mention he was able to get my in as soon as I called and had me out the door within an hour. I cannot recommend this place enough. I will be 100% going back if I have any tech issues.

fiveStarReviews.author: Emrah Asar
fiveStarReviews.text:
The best service and technicians here!
Any computer or laptop issues they are the best in town, I had my computer completely powered out and I couldn’t bring it back on. I had very important data that was work related and personal.. They helped me recover all my data and transfer to another computer. I highly recommend this place !

fiveStarReviews.author: Derick Pritchett
fiveStarReviews.text: I previously left a bad review however it was my misunderstanding...he was able to help me solve my problem and help get me up and running despite my initial dissatisfaction..I wish I hadn't left the bad review...he does good work and very fair and reasonable!
